title: Capabilities Ain't All You Need: Measuring Propensities in AI
abstract: arXiv:2602.18182v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI evaluation has primarily focused on measuring capabilities, with formal approaches inspired from Item Response Theory (IRT) being increasingly applied. Yet propensities - the tendencies of models to exhibit particular behaviours - play a central role in determining both performance and safety outcomes. However, traditional IRT describes a model's success on a task as a monotonic function of model capabilities and task demands, an approach unsuited to propensities, where both excess and deficiency can be problematic. Here, we introduce the first formal framework for measuring AI propensities by using a bilogistic formulation for model success, which attributes high success probability when the model's propensity is within an "ideal band". translated_title: 能力并非一切所需：衡量人工智能中的行为倾向性
translated_abstract: AI评估主要聚焦于衡量模型能力，受项目反应理论（IRT）启发的形式化方法正得到日益广泛的应用。然而，倾向性——即模型表现出特定行为的趋势——在决定性能和安全性结果方面起着核心作用。但传统的IRT将模型在任务上的成功描述为模型能力与任务需求的单调函数，这种方法不适用于倾向性，因为对于倾向性而言，过度和不足都可能是有问题的。在此，我们引入了首个用于衡量AI倾向性的形式化框架，该框架采用双逻辑斯蒂函数来建模模型成功，当模型的倾向性处于“理想区间”内时，该函数会赋予较高的成功概率。此外，我们利用配备了新开发的、与任务无关的评分标准的大语言模型来估计理想区间的边界。我们将该框架应用于六个大语言模型家族，这些模型的倾向性……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个衡量AI行为倾向性的形式化框架，采用双逻辑斯蒂函数建模，当模型倾向性处于“理想区间”内时赋予高成功概率，弥补了传统基于项目反应理论的能力评估方法无法处理“过度与不足皆有问题”这一倾向性特征的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first formal framework for measuring AI propensities using a bilogistic formulation that assigns high success probability when a model's propensity falls within an "ideal band", addressing the inadequacy of traditional monotonic IRT-based capability evaluation where both excess and deficiency can be problematic.
